value: apparition capable of repeating child's phrases and enacting small, local physical motions (doll push, chalk mark, timing of footfalls)
quote: When I set the doll on the joist it moved, not with the theatrics of a story but with a single, practicable push. ... On the attic hatch, fresh white strokes formed the single, wobbly letter of a child's name: an E. ... The voice that followed did its small, circling thing: "Don't tell." ... The measured footfalls that had occupied the house stopped as if someone had wound down a watch.
